name: The Silent Heraldry
introDiscord:
Royal announcement halls line the next district.

Ancient Heralds still stand on balconies waiting to proclaim news to a
population that left centuries ago.
introTwitch:
Royal announcement halls line the next district.

Ancient Heralds still stand on balconies waiting to proclaim news to a
population that left centuries ago.

the-silent-heraldry-approach.prompt: The Silent Heraldry opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A proclamation podium contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Haunted Herald raises a ceremonial staff.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle rests beside a proclamation:

'HEAR YE HEAR YE:

Glimmer has been promoted to Royal Lamp.

Glimmer objects to title.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

the-silent-heraldry-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Silent Heraldry, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Herald steps from an announcement balcony.

right.message: A royal message chest contains Star Candies.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath another proclamation:

'OFFICIAL DECREE:

Berries are now legal tender.

Issued by Queen Shizuki.

Authority:

self-appointed.'

the-silent-heraldry-threshold.prompt: Near Proclamation Hall, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: Restorative salts sit in a herald's station.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Haunted Herald blocks Proclamation Hall.

forward.message: A ceremonial dispatch box contains Star Candies.

bossPromptDiscord:
The old proclamation bells ring.

One final Herald takes the central balcony.

Use /yes to hear the kingdom's last announcement or /no to
continue ignoring unauthorized royal decrees.
bossPromptTwitch:
The old proclamation bells ring.

One final Herald takes the central balcony.

Use !yes to hear the kingdom's last announcement or !no to
continue ignoring unauthorized royal decrees.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Proclamation Hall. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The proclamation hall quiets.

Shizuki's decree remains posted.

Berry-based economy officially unofficial.
